* **Inventories:**

  * *Average Inventory:* $(1,642.2 + 1,559.3) / 2 = \mathbf{\$1,600.75 \text{ million}}$

  * *Average Accounts Payable:* $(2,746.2 + 2,854.1) / 2 = \mathbf{\$2,800.15 \text{ million}}$

  $$\text{DIO} = \frac{365 \times \text{Average Inventory}}{\text{COGS}} = \frac{365 \times 1,600.75}{11,108.4} = \mathbf{52.58 \text{ days}}$$

---

### **3. Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC):**
$$\text{CCC} = \text{DIO} + \text{DSO} - \text{DPO}$$
$$\text{CCC} = 52.58 + 36.41 - 92.69 = \mathbf{-3.70 \text{ days}}$$

* **Accounts Payable (As of January 31, 2017 / FY2017):** $41,433 million
* **Cost of Sales (COGS for FY2018):** $373,396 million
* **Inventories (As of January 31, 2018 / FY2018):** $43,783 million
* **Inventories (As of January 31, 2017 / FY2017):** $43,046 million

**2. Calculate Average Accounts Payable:**
$$\text{Average Accounts Payable} = \frac{46,092 + 41,433}{2} = \frac{87,525}{2} = 43,762.5 \text{ million}$$

**3. Calculate Change in Inventory (FY2018 Inventory minus FY2017 Inventory):**
$$\text{Change in Inventory} = 43,783 - 43,046 = 737 \text{ million}$$

**4. Calculate the Denominator:**
$$\text{Denominator} = \text{FY2018 COGS} + \text{Change in Inventory}$$
$$\text{Denominator} = 373,396 + 737 = 374,133 \text{ million}$$

**5. Calculate DPO:**
$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times \frac{\text{Average Accounts Payable}}{\text{Denominator}}$$
$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times \frac{43,762.5}{374,133}$$
$$\text{DPO} = 365 \times 0.1169707 = 42.6943$$
